title: An Open-Weight Model Proves a Logic Theorem
blurb: A research agent running an open-weight model (Kimi K3) formalized the four-valued logic FDE in Lean 4 and proved it sound, complete, and decidable — every proof checked by the kernel, every axiom reported, every wrong turn logged. The leaderboard of AI-proved math is dominated by closed models; this is the open-stack version
source: fde-lean project in the hermes-matilde container on the Mini; repo being prepared for public release
